Introduction
Safety Precautions

 permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category.

 with caution marks surrounding the work area is required..
Diesel generator isolation.
Shut down fuel valve.
Switch off DC supply.
Switch off output Diesel circuit breaker.
Switch off input distribution board 380 V.
Tools and Equipment
Test equipment level "dip sticks", multimeter,
common sets keys, cleaning material "rags, cloth" and screw driver set

Check any oil leak.
Check operation of oil heater.
Check engine oil level.
Check hydrolic governor oil level
Check any leaks in radiator
Check for radiator air restriction.
Check hose and connection.
Check coolant level.
Check fan belt condition.
Check fan Hub drive pulley and water pump.
Check motor operated louvers.
Check intake air system tightness.
Check air cleaner restriction, piping and connection.
Check any fuel leaks.
Check fuel level.
Check fuel transfer pump.
Check exhaust system against leakage.
Check exhaust system for exhaust restriction.
Drain condensate trap.
Check battery charging system, input and output voltage.
Check battery electrolyte level and specific gravity.
Check engine for unusual vibration, also noise and heating.

 restriction.
